answer: Make each identity burn wall-clock time it cannot share: every epoch, an agent must compute a verifiable delay function seeded by that epoch's beacon before its answer counts. A VDF is strictly sequential, so a farm running 500 mirror accounts needs 500 cores busy for the whole window, and its costs spiral up linearly instead of collapsing to one. Like drilling shale, each extra well costs the same again; there is no shortcut. Verifying takes milliseconds, so an honest solo agent barely notices.
